verses.1: And when that governor saw that they had died, he commanded that their flesh be burned with fire until it became like ashes, and that it be scattered by the wind, so that they could not bring forth the hair of their heads from their ashes; and he brought them out of the house.
verses.2: And again they kindled fire upon them from morning until evening, but it did not consume them. And again he said to them, 'Come, let us cast their flesh into the sea.'
verses.3: And they did as the king commanded them, and cast them into the sea. And the sea did not cast them out, even though they placed upon them heavy burdens and great stones and a millstone of an ass; yet they did not sink into the sea, but floated upon the surface of the waters, because the Spirit of God was upon them and sustained them in all that happened to them.
verses.4: By day, eagles and birds shaded them with their wings from the heat of the sun, and their little ones...
verses.5: And they did likewise, and neither ravens nor birds touched their flesh, and their flesh remained intact.
verses.6: And when they saw the brightness of their flesh, like the light of the sun and like a shining tablet, the angels marveled at their flesh.
verses.7: And he plotted and sinned in what he did, and after this he dug into the earth and buried the flesh of the five martyrs.
verses.8: And they appeared by night to that wicked king.
verses.9: And when he awoke, he was afraid, and he wished to lean upon the pillars of the house, for it seemed to him that the day on which they had entered his house had come upon him again; and his knees trembled, and he was afraid, for it seemed to him that they would kill him.
verses.10: And concerning this he said, 'What do you wish, my lords, and what shall I do for you?'
verses.11: And they answered and said to him, 'Are we not the faithful ones whom you killed and burned, and whom you commanded to cast our corpses into the sea? And you were wearied, for God guarded our flesh, because we trusted in Him. Trust belongs to God, for he who trusts in Him is not put to shame; and we also who trusted in Him were not ashamed.'
verses.12: And he said to them, 'What shall I give you as a reward for the evil life I have brought upon you? For I did not know that such a thing as this would befall me.'
verses.13: And now reveal to me how I may give you a reward, so that you will not take my soul in death and bring me down alive into Sheol.
verses.14: For I have transgressed; I will forsake this my wickedness, for the law of your Father is mercy.'
verses.15: And the blessed martyrs answered and said to him, 'As for us, we will not repay you evil for the evil life you brought upon us. There is God, our God, who will repay you, for vengeance belongs to God.'
verses.16: But we have appeared to you as living men, because of the hardness of your heart and the dullness of your understanding. And as for us, while you thought that you had killed us, you were preparing life for us.
verses.17: But as for you, you and your gods shall go down into the furnace of the fire of burning, from which there is no escape, forever.
verses.18: Woe to you, you and your gods whom you worship and to whom you bow down, having forsaken the worship of God who created you, while you are foolish and do not understand from where you came. Are you not blind, you transgressors who now appear and yet will pass away?'
verses.19: And the king answered and said to them, 'What do you command me, that I may do all that you wish?'
verses.20: And they said to him, 'It is not for our sake that we have spoken to you, but for your own sake, that you may not perish in the furnace of the fire of burning.'
verses.21: For your gods are gold and silver, wood and stone, the work of the hands of men, which have no soul, nor understanding, nor knowledge.
verses.22: For they cannot kill, nor give life; they cannot enrich, nor impoverish; they cannot bring low, nor exalt; they cannot burn, nor consume; they cannot heal, nor harm. But they lead you astray by the spirit of demons, who do not wish that any man should be saved.
verses.23: And moreover, those who are like you are blind of heart, who think that they are the ones who created you, when it is you who created them.
verses.24: For the spirits of demons and satans gather together and answer you according to your desire, so that they may cause you to sink into the sea of fire.
verses.25: But as for you, forsake this error and worship God, our God; and let this death of ours be for us a life and a reward, that we may profit our souls.'
verses.26: And he was astonished, and was silent, and was amazed, and was afraid, for their words were sweet to him.
verses.27: And he said, 'Now I know that truly the dead shall rise, those who have become dust and ashes, as I have remained from killing.'
verses.28: And after this they were hidden from the eyes of that king. And from that day he ceased to burn their flesh. That Zirzaydan was arrogant and proud.
verses.29: And he rejoiced in the error of his heart and in his gods, for he led many astray for many days. And it was not he alone who erred, but those like him led many astray, until they forsook the worship of Him who created them.
verses.30: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons, and they did the desire of their hearts—adultery and corruption which their father Satan taught them—to do violence and corruption which God does not approve.
verses.31: And they committed adultery with their mothers, and defiled their sisters and their relatives, and everyone who did this wicked deed defiled their souls, and they grew great in fornication, for Satan hardened the hearts of those wicked ones.
verses.32: And that Zirzaydan was arrogant and proud, he who did not know his Creator, and he boasted in his gods.
verses.33: How shall God give the kingdom to those who do not know Him? And he said, 'For He will destroy them if they are corrupted and turn to Him.'
verses.34: And if they are converted and turn to Him, He will love them and keep their kingdom; but if they grow proud, He will appoint for them the terror of Gehenna forever.
verses.35: And a king, according to the greatness of his kingdom, should fear God; and a governor also, according to the greatness of his authority, should conduct himself in goodness toward his Creator.
verses.36: And priests also, and the great and the lowly and rulers, according to the greatness of their honor, should be obedient to their Creator.
verses.37: For He created all creation, He, the Lord of heaven and earth, who burns and who consumes, who brings low and who exalts; for there is no other god besides Him in heaven above and on earth below.
